caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a dress composed of three main colored sections: pink, green, and brown. The bodice and upper sleeves of the dress are primarily pink, accented with pink fringe trimmings at the neckline, cuffs, and edges. The bodice features a row of green buttons on the front and is adorned with green ribbons at the left shoulder and the right wrist. The skirt is divided into two main layers: the top layer is green with a subtle patterned texture, decorated with pink trim along the edges, and gathered at intervals to reveal a brown underlayer. The bottom, brown section of the skirt extends outward and is additionally trimmed with pink fringe along the hem. To the upper right of the main dress drawing, a faint, incomplete sketch of the dress is visible, outlining its shape and general form without color or detail. The background is an off-white color and features no additional objects or patterns.
title: Dress
